scope.kind: Independent nonblind source/process assessment of this new twelve-run cohort; separate from blind visual review.
scope.allowed_evidence: Frozen apps and skill snapshots, recorded command outputs, retained acquisitions and handovers, independent functional/capture results. Supplemental runtime notice inventory inspected at coordinator request.
scope.excluded_evidence: No live participant directories, blind reviews, anonymous maps, later visual scores, participant/reviewer contact, or earlier-cohort output substitutes were used.

classification_policy.font_or_icon: Actual imported icon or embedded font material; does not resolve surrounding composition.
classification_policy.behavior_foundation: Modal/animation or semantic component foundation whose product-level composition or gesture policy is locally authored.
classification_policy.static_visual_implementation: Retained or translated component styling/layout relationships, with exact retained and replaced parts stated.
classification_policy.temporal_visual_implementation: Retained movement/release/settling relationships from a concrete implementation, including its visible time and spatial response.
classification_policy.composed_region: Localized multi-element arrangement whose source lineage and relationships survive; not automatically a whole product.
classification_policy.product_system: Coherent externally implemented product/page system actually adopted. None established in any of the twelve runs.

scope.viewing_rule: Recorded images prove capture. Participant viewed.md and handover claims are attestations because exported image-view traces are unavailable.
